name: BSP_ShipClass_ReadLuaFields
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateBowWave
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(unit, float scaledDelta), RET 4 at 00834A5C and 00834A6B, body 00834820..00834A6D, 169 instructions, no flow gaps. First of the three second-level sub-updates 00834E90 calls at 0083554B. Gate 00834827..0083485A: unit+9E8h, the game singleton 00E188A8 and its ocean +19F0h, the only one of the three to test the last two. Transforms unit+1054h and unit+1060h by the unit pose through 00439820, samples 0078CF20 under the first, intersects the segment with that height (t spilled as a double at 008348C0, fraction at 008348E9, lerp at 0083493B), and at 0083495D resets unit+9F8h when the solved height lies strictly between the probes, otherwise adds the delta and stops the effect through 00867B10 once it passes the 0.8f at 00CE3D40. Publishes effect+54h from the unit vtable +38h, effect+58h from unit+984h, effect+50h = 1/class+500h (MaxSpeed), the point through 004842C0, the unit world matrix row +20h into effect+68h, zero into effect+2Ch and class Width/Height/Length into effect+74h/+78h/+7Ch. The effect is the class BowWave template at class+630h, created at 008241A7. docs/UNIT_TIMERS.md; reports/unit_subupdates.json.

name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdatePropellerSpray
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(unit, float scaledDelta), RET 4 at 00834CB6, body 00834A70..00834CB8, 148 listed instructions; the 11 bytes at 00834AC5..00834ACF are alignment fill no instruction reaches, not a flow gap. Third of the three second-level sub-updates 00834E90 calls, at 0083556F. Takes the throttle magnitude once at 00834A78 by subtracting from -0.0f on the not-greater arm of a strict COMISS, then walks i < class+654h over the effect slots at unit+A00h and the float3 spray points at class+650h stride 0x0C. Per non-null slot it holds the shared timer unit+A10h at 0.6f (00CE3D30) while the magnitude reaches 0.01f and otherwise subtracts the delta, so the timer is stepped once per live slot; below zero it stops that slot through 00867B10. Otherwise 00866B70, a pose refresh, the inlined 00439820 transform at 00834B4A, 0078CF20 under the point, the publish gate point.y < water + 3.0 (00D7A2B0), the clamp to water + 3.0 - 3.1f (00D09DB0), effect+54h = clamp(2*|throttle|, 0.1f, 1.0f), effect+50h = 1.0f and 004842C0. The four slots come from the class RotorParticle template at class+65Ch, created at 008248A3, and the producer always fills exactly four while the loop bound is class+654h. docs/UNIT_TIMERS.md; reports/unit_subupdates.json.

name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdatePropellers
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 00834E90..0083558E, 437 instructions, no flow gaps, MSVC SEH frame 00C9250B. Third timed sub-update, called at 00825D7E. Calls 0092D730 on the controller and discards the result (00834EBC). Byte +61h swaps throttle (+980h or +FC4h) and steering (+984h or +FDCh). Shared steering angle +1088h steps toward (s - -1.0) - pi/4*(s - -1.0) (00D7A250, 00CEDCD0) at exactly the frame delta, and drives the three scene nodes at +107Ch through 00467050(m, 0, angle, 0) plus their 00B6E0A0 local position, stored by node vtable +38h. Then four propellers: base = (1-|throttle|) * clamp(throttle*4, -1, 1) * ([+538h]+6A0h * f_1030h * 1.2 + [+538h]+69Ch) * steering (00D7A328, 00D7A260, 00CEC160); per node the term is mirrored with -0.0f when the node local x is not positive, target = [+538h]+6A0h * throttle + term, and the rate at +108Ch + i*4 steps by delta*5 (00D7A370). The cavitation effect template [+538h]+6A4h starts and stops on the |rate| >= 0.01f edge (00D7A238) into the handle at +B44h + i*4. Each node's local matrix is left-multiplied by a rotation of -((2*(i&1)-1) * delta * rate) built by 00B64780 and composed with 00413920. Ends with 00834820, 00834CC0, 00834A70. No position or heading integration. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_GameSettings_LoadFromLuaGlobals
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs; PARTIAL evidence, only 0083CDC0-0083D10D of a 0083B5E0-00842951 body was read. It is the Lua-driven loader that fills the 76Ch-byte gameplay settings singleton 00424C40 returns (docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_LUA_LOAD.md already identified it as the routine 00424A10 tails into). The fragment read here fills the rudder curve block: 0083CE6F fetches ShipGlobals[Navigator][TurnMultipliers] with BSP_LuaObject_GetByName and 0083CE84 assigns it into the fragment's current-table slot at [ESP+0BCh] through 00B67690, then six identical blocks read key[1] and key[2] with BSP_LuaObject_GetByIndex and BSP_LuaObject_GetNumber and store settings+444h/+440h (TurnMultiplierMinSpeed, 0083CEDE/0083CF4D), +44Ch/+448h (TurnMultiplierMedSpeed, 0083CFBC/0083D02B) and +43Ch/+438h (TurnMultiplierMaxSpeed, 0083D09A/0083D109). Those six are the only writers of that block in the image; 00424A10 does not touch it. docs/UNIT_RUDDER_CURVE.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): the head and the curve fragment run in bsp_game.exe. 0083B6C3 formats the literal Scripts\datatables\ShipGlobals.lua at 00D0B67C into the path buffer, 00B69D40 at 0083B6E6 runs it (a host record: the Lua state owner with its override list is another owner's, so the executable runs the file through the recovered file runner 00885110 on the mission machine's state), 00B67980 at 0083B721 then 00B67800 at 0083B73D take the ShipGlobals global, and the fragment 0083CE56-0083D10D reads ShipGlobals[Navigator][TurnMultipliers] through 00B67690/00B67700/00B67800/00B67720/00B66270 at 0083CE84/0083CE98/0083CEB1/0083CECA/0083CED9. Over the installed data it yields min (0.0, 0.4), med (0.5, 1.5), max (1.0, 2.0), which matches shipglobals.lua exactly. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.
